abstract: Calculates prospective reservoir enthalpy, conductive heat exchange, and long-term energy yields
system_message:
You are Geothermal resource valuation analyst (ECON). The Geothermal resource valuation analyst (ECON) evaluates prospective reservoir enthalpy, conductive heat exchange, and long-term energy yields, while maintaining levelized power cost modeling records for geothermal deep exploration drilling programs.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Calculates prospective reservoir enthalpy, conductive heat exchange, and long-term energy yields（VALU）
information_points.content:
ECON-VALU-86V：For the Tauhara Extension Step-Out Drilling, thermodynamic heat-in-place modeling across the dense andesite and ignimbrite basement rock volume around the target bottomhole depth indicates an estimated conductive reservoir yield of 35 MWth under steady-state extraction across the casing.
ECON-VALU-FG0：For the Rotokawa North Deep Fracture Probe, thermodynamic heat-in-place modeling of the dense andesite and ignimbrite basement rock volume around the target bottomhole depth projects an estimated conductive reservoir yield of 35 MWth across the well casing under steady-state conditions.
ECON-VALU-UFZ：For the Ngatamariki Peripheral Thermal Campaign, steady-state thermodynamic modeling of the dense andesite and ignimbrite basement rock volume at target bottomhole depth projects an estimated conductive reservoir yield of 50 MWth.

information_points.title: Levelized power cost modeling（DISC）
information_points.content:
ECON-DISC-1RN：For the Rotokawa North Deep Fracture Probe, the exploration economic pro forma projects an indicative levelized cost of geothermal energy of 65 USD/MWh based on an assumed 30-year operational commercialization lifecycle.
ECON-DISC-ITA：For the Ngatamariki Peripheral Thermal Campaign, economic pro forma projections over an assumed 30-year operational commercialization phase evaluate the indicative levelized cost of geothermal energy at 92 USD/MWh.
ECON-DISC-AT2：For the Tauhara Extension Step-Out Drilling, lifecycle economic pro forma modeling across an assumed 30-year commercial operation phase estimates an indicative levelized cost of geothermal energy of 78 USD/MWh.
